title: Glass Harp
tagline: Wet-finger crystal glasses: rub the rim to sing, drag the water to tune.
how_to: Turn sound on, circle a finger on a glass rim; drag a glass up or down to change its water.
description: Five crystal glasses stand on a table, each filled to a different level. Rub a rim and it slowly builds a pure, shimmering tone while the rim visibly wobbles and the water ripples. Drag a glass's body to pour or drain water and watch the pitch glide; switch off snapping for free tuning.
spark: Glass taken literally: a glass harmonica, with glass drawn as translucent, refracting-looking tumblers.
proud_of: The rim itself deforms in a two-lobe vibration mode as it sings, and speed of rubbing controls how loud it grows.
